e.title_en: UW Markdown — an open underwriting interoperability standard (AI never does the math; results verifiable to the digit)
e.title_hk: UW Markdown · 承保互操作開放標準（AI 不做算術，結果可核驗到小數點）
e.summary: 把承保案件写成 .uw.md 的开放标准：确定性引擎重算 NOI/DSCR/IRR、附核验回执与签名，并给出 MCP/HTTP 绑定
e.summary_en: An open standard writing underwriting deals as .uw.md: deterministic engines recompute NOI/DSCR/IRR, with verification receipts and signing, plus MCP/HTTP bindings
e.summary_hk: 把承保案件寫成 .uw.md 的開放標準：確定性引擎重算 NOI/DSCR/IRR、附核驗回執與簽名，並提供 MCP/HTTP 綁定
e.body:
**必须先说清适用范围**：UW Markdown（UWMD，官网 `uwmd.org`，仓库 `github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown`）是**商业地产/信贷口径的「承保」**（underwriting）标准——即**贷款人核贷**场景，术语是 NOI、DSCR、IRR、waterfall、credit memo、lender package，**不是产险/寿险的核保标准**。把它收进本 wiki 的理由在下面「为什么值得收」一节，但**先把边界讲明白**。

可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、仓库 **2026-08-07 创建、2026-09-10 仍在推送**、**6,926 KB**、**TypeScript**、**★1、0 fork**；官网 `uwmd.org` HTTP 200（32.8KB），站点状态栏自述 **PROJECT STATUS: ACTIVE ｜ Format v2.0 ｜ Protocol v2.3.0 ｜ Core v2.3.0 ｜ License MIT ｜ Updated 2026-09-03**。实测仓库 **1,355 个文件**，规格齐全：`spec/` 下有 **格式规范 v1 与 v2、LITE 规范、PROTOCOL、RECEIPT（回执）、COMPOSITION、XML 映射、CSV Bundle**；`spec/bindings/` 下有 **HTTP API 的 OpenAPI 定义**与 **`UW_MCP_BINDING_v1.md`（MCP 绑定）**；`spec/schemas/` 下有 `calc-result`、`edit-operation`、`module-signature`、`implementation-manifest`、`protocol-error`、`issue-remediation`、`module-manifest` 等 JSON Schema；另有 **`conformance/` 一致性测试样例**（`.uw.md` 输入与 expected 输出，含「单位不匹配」「未知字段」「frontmatter 缺失」等反例）。工程侧另有 GOVERNANCE、MAINTAINERS、ROADMAP、SECURITY、VERSIONS、CONTRIBUTING、CODE_OF_CONDUCT 与 **AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md**。npm 上为**一套 8 个包**：`@uwmd/core`（v2.6.1，2026-09-10 发布，**17 个版本**）、`@uwmd/cli`（`npx uwmd init|parse|validate|render|run`）、`@uwmd/report`（PDF/贷方包）、`@uwmd/signing`（**Ed25519 / ES256 / ES384** 的区块与**回执签名**）、`@uwmd/batch`、`@uwmd/excel`、`@uwmd/module-data-center`、`@uwmd/module-hospitality`。

**它的核心主张，也正是本 wiki 最该记下来的一句**（官网原文）：**「AI never does the financial math: every NOI, DSCR, IRR, and waterfall split is recomputed by deterministic engines, attested by verification receipts, and portable into any data lake.」**——**AI 不负责算钱**：所有 NOI/DSCR/IRR 与 waterfall 分配**由确定性引擎重算**，并**附核验回执（verification receipts）**，可整体搬进数据湖。配套的机器交换设计同样明确：**UW Document Envelope 1.0** 是同一套模型背后的共享结构，**确定性 UW JSON 1.0 / UW XML 1.0 / 规范化 UW CSV Bundle 1.0 三种表示共存**，且**三者都保留 provenance、prose、扩展、数组与「被取代历史（superseded history）」并校验同一个语义 SHA-256 摘要**。

为什么值得收（三层理由）：**① 它是「AI 必须不做算术」这一原则的最完整工程样本**——池内已有多条同源思路：[[quorumforge]]（确定性裁决）、[[clarity-sdk]]（确定性 + 受监管的文档抽取）、[[bind-standard]]（机器可读交换）、[[actuarial-ts]]（TS 原生精算数学 + ASOP 23 合规），而 UWMD 把**「确定性重算 + 回执 + 签名 + 一致性测试 + MCP/HTTP 绑定」四件套**一次性做全，**这是保险 AI 落地时最难拼齐的一环**；**② 它给出了 agent 时代数据标准的形状**——**格式规范 + JSON Schema + OpenAPI + MCP 绑定 + conformance fixtures 同步发布**，其中**「MCP 绑定」与「给 AI 的 bounded agent skills」直接进规范正文**，这在承保/核保这类文书密集场景里是现成模板；**③ 业务邻接**：保险公司的**不动产与信贷敞口**（抵押贷款保险、贷方置保险、自有物业与债权组合）与这套口径直接相关，且**「同一条款不同版本/被取代历史」的记录方式**与上一轮 [[clausegraph]] 遇到的**约款时点版本问题**是同一类难题的另一种解法（一个用图谱、一个用带 provenance 的确定性文档模型）。相关条目：[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]（保险数据标准的在位者）、[[bind-standard]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[morphir]]、[[reactor-dsl]]、[[actuarial-ts]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[clausegraph]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 领域边界**——它是**商业地产/信贷承保**标准，**不是保险核保标准**，本词条**不主张其适用于产险/寿险核保**；**② ★1、0 fork、仓库无描述字段**，属**极早期、无社区采用**；**③ 迭代极快**（`@uwmd/core` 一个月内 17 个版本、规格已到 v2.0），**接口与规范仍在变动**；**④** 官网的能力陈述与站点状态均为**项目自述**，本次核实到**规范文件、Schema、一致性样例、8 个 npm 包与仓库结构**层面，**未安装、未运行、未跑一致性测试**；**⑤** 站点「Updated 2026-09-03」与仓库「2026-09-10 推送」**不是同一天**，两者各自如实记录。**核实说明**：官网 HTTP 200（32.8KB）、GitHub 仓库页 HTTP 200（352KB）、仓库完整文件树（1,355 文件）、4 个 npm 包的 registry 元数据与 README 均实测；**未安装、未运行**。
e.body_en:
**Scope first**: UW Markdown (UWMD; site `uwmd.org`, repository `github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown`) is a **commercial real-estate / credit** underwriting standard — the **lender credit** sense, whose vocabulary is NOI, DSCR, IRR, waterfall, credit memo and lender package — **not a P&C or life insurance underwriting standard**. The reasons for including it in this wiki are set out below, but **the boundary comes first**.

Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, repository **created 2026-08-07, still pushed on 2026-09-10**, **6,926 KB**, **TypeScript**, **1 star, 0 forks**; the site `uwmd.org` measured HTTP 200 (32.8KB) and its status block reads **PROJECT STATUS: ACTIVE | Format v2.0 | Protocol v2.3.0 | Core v2.3.0 | License MIT | Updated 2026-09-03**. The repository was measured at **1,355 files** with a complete specification set: under `spec/` are the **format specs v1 and v2, a LITE spec, PROTOCOL, RECEIPT, COMPOSITION, an XML mapping and a CSV Bundle**; `spec/bindings/` holds an **OpenAPI definition for the HTTP API** and **`UW_MCP_BINDING_v1.md` (the MCP binding)**; `spec/schemas/` holds JSON Schemas including `calc-result`, `edit-operation`, `module-signature`, `implementation-manifest`, `protocol-error`, `issue-remediation` and `module-manifest`; there is also a **`conformance/` consistency-test suite** (`.uw.md` inputs with expected outputs, including negative cases such as "unit mismatch", "unknown field" and "missing frontmatter"). Engineering norms are covered too: GOVERNANCE, MAINTAINERS, ROADMAP, SECURITY, VERSIONS, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT and **AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md**. On npm it ships as **a set of eight packages**: `@uwmd/core` (v2.6.1, published 2026-09-10, **17 versions**), `@uwmd/cli` (`npx uwmd init|parse|validate|render|run`), `@uwmd/report` (PDF / lender package), `@uwmd/signing` (**Ed25519 / ES256 / ES384** block and **receipt signing**), `@uwmd/batch`, `@uwmd/excel`, `@uwmd/module-data-center` and `@uwmd/module-hospitality`.

**Its central claim is also the sentence this wiki should keep** (from the site): **"AI never does the financial math: every NOI, DSCR, IRR, and waterfall split is recomputed by deterministic engines, attested by verification receipts, and portable into any data lake."** The machine-interchange design is equally explicit: **UW Document Envelope 1.0** is the shared model behind **deterministic UW JSON 1.0, UW XML 1.0 and a normalized UW CSV Bundle 1.0**, and **all three preserve provenance, prose, extensions, arrays and superseded history while verifying the same semantic SHA-256 digest**.

Why include it — three reasons. **① It is the most complete engineering sample of the "AI must not do the arithmetic" principle.** This corpus already holds kindred entries — [[quorumforge]] (deterministic adjudication), [[clarity-sdk]] (deterministic, regulated document extraction), [[bind-standard]] (machine-readable interchange) and [[actuarial-ts]] (TypeScript-native actuarial maths with ASOP 23 compliance) — and UWMD assembles the full set of four in one place: **deterministic recomputation + receipts + signing + a conformance suite + MCP/HTTP bindings**. That is precisely the part insurance AI deployments find hardest to assemble. **② It shows the shape of a data standard in the agent era** — a **format spec, JSON Schemas, an OpenAPI definition, an MCP binding and conformance fixtures released together**, with **"the MCP binding" and "bounded agent skills for AI" written into the specification itself**; in document-heavy workflows like underwriting that is a ready template. **③ Business adjacency**: insurers’ **real-estate and credit exposures** (mortgage insurance, lender-placed insurance, owned property and debt portfolios) sit directly on this vocabulary, and its **"superseded history"** record-keeping is another solution to the same class of problem [[clausegraph]] hit last round (which policy-wording version applies) — one solves it with a graph, this one with a provenance-carrying deterministic document model. Related: [[acord]] and [[acord-mcp-architecture]] (the incumbent in insurance data standards), [[bind-standard]], [[risk-data-library-standard]], [[payout-assurance-standard]], [[morphir]], [[reactor-dsl]], [[actuarial-ts]], [[quorumforge]], [[clarity-sdk]], [[clausegraph]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① domain boundary** — this is a **commercial real-estate / credit underwriting** standard, **not an insurance underwriting standard**, and this entry **does not claim applicability to P&C or life underwriting**; **② at 1 star and 0 forks with no repository description**, it is **very early with no community adoption**; **③ iteration is extremely fast** (`@uwmd/core` shipped 17 versions in a month and the spec is already at v2.0), so **interfaces and the specification are still moving**; **④** the site’s capability statements and status block are **the project’s own**; this check reached the **spec files, schemas, conformance fixtures, eight npm packages and repository structure** — **nothing was installed or run, and no conformance suite was executed**; **⑤** the site says "Updated 2026-09-03" while the repository was pushed **2026-09-10** — **not the same day**, and both are reported as found. **Verification note**: the site (HTTP 200, 32.8KB), the GitHub repository page (HTTP 200, 352KB), the full repository file tree (1,355 files) and the registry metadata and READMEs of four npm packages were all measured; **nothing was installed or run**.

**先說清適用範圍**：UW Markdown（UWMD，官網 `uwmd.org`，倉庫 `github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown`）是**商業地產／信貸口徑的「承保」（underwriting）**標準——即**貸款人核貸**場景，術語是 NOI、DSCR、IRR、waterfall、credit memo、lender package，**不是產險／壽險的核保標準**。收錄理由見下文，但**邊界先講明白**。

可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**、倉庫 **2026-08-07 建立、2026-09-10 仍在推送**、**6,926 KB**、**TypeScript**、**★1、0 fork**；官網 HTTP 200（32.8KB），狀態欄自述 **ACTIVE ｜ Format v2.0 ｜ Protocol v2.3.0 ｜ Core v2.3.0 ｜ MIT ｜ Updated 2026-09-03**。實測倉庫 **1,355 個檔案**：`spec/` 下有**格式規範 v1/v2、LITE 規範、PROTOCOL、RECEIPT（回執）、COMPOSITION、XML 映射、CSV Bundle**；`spec/bindings/` 下有 **HTTP API 的 OpenAPI 定義**與 **`UW_MCP_BINDING_v1.md`（MCP 綁定）**；`spec/schemas/` 下有 `calc-result`、`module-signature`、`implementation-manifest` 等 JSON Schema；另有 **`conformance/` 一致性測試樣例**（含「單位不匹配」「未知欄位」「frontmatter 缺失」等反例）。npm 上為**一套 8 個包**：`@uwmd/core`（v2.6.1，**17 個版本**）、`@uwmd/cli`、`@uwmd/report`、`@uwmd/signing`（**Ed25519 / ES256 / ES384 回執簽名**）、`@uwmd/batch`、`@uwmd/excel`、`@uwmd/module-data-center`、`@uwmd/module-hospitality`。

**核心主張，也是本 wiki 最該記下的一句**（官網原文）：**「AI never does the financial math: every NOI, DSCR, IRR, and waterfall split is recomputed by deterministic engines, attested by verification receipts, and portable into any data lake.」**——**AI 不負責算錢**。配套設計：**UW Document Envelope 1.0** 為共享模型，**UW JSON / UW XML / UW CSV Bundle 三種表示共存**，**都保留 provenance、prose、擴展、陣列與「被取代歷史」並校驗同一個語義 SHA-256 摘要**。

為何值得收：**① 它是「AI 必須不做算術」原則最完整的工程樣本**——池內同源思路有 [[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[actuarial-ts]]，而 UWMD 把**確定性重算 + 回執 + 簽名 + 一致性測試 + MCP／HTTP 綁定**一次做全；**② 它給出 agent 時代數據標準的形狀**——**格式規範 + JSON Schema + OpenAPI + MCP 綁定 + conformance fixtures 同步發布**；**③ 業務鄰接**：保險公司的**不動產與信貸敞口**（抵押貸款保險、貸方置保險）與這套口徑直接相關，其**「被取代歷史」**與上輪 [[clausegraph]] 的**約款時點版本**是同一類難題的另一種解法。相關：[[acord]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[morphir]]、[[reactor-dsl]]、[[actuarial-ts]]、[[quorumforge]]、[[clarity-sdk]]、[[clausegraph]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 領域邊界**——**商業地產／信貸承保**標準，**非保險核保標準**；**② ★1、0 fork、倉庫無描述**，**極早期、無社區採用**；**③ 迭代極快**（一個月 17 個版本、規範已到 v2.0），**接口仍在變動**；**④** 官網陳述為**項目自述**，本次核實到**規範檔案、Schema、一致性樣例、8 個 npm 包與倉庫結構**層面，**未安裝、未運行、未跑一致性測試**；**⑤** 官網「Updated 2026-09-03」與倉庫「2026-09-10 推送」**並非同日**，兩者各自如實記錄。**核實說明**：官網、倉庫頁、完整文件樹（1,355 檔案）、4 個 npm 包元數據與 README 均實測；**未安裝、未運行**。
